item.title: Frontend Decluttering in 2026: The 5 Technologies Worth Your Time
item.description: Overwhelmed by frontend frameworks? In 2026, only React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, and TanStack Query truly matter. This guide helps you cut through the noise.

item.title: Does JavaScript Really Lose to GPU? Three Real Benchmarks That Baffled Me
item.description: Particle simulation, matrix multiplication, image processing—real performance comparisons between WebGPU and JavaScript that yield surprising results. Not all scenarios need GPU; sometimes CPU does the job better.

item.title: Tired of Waiting for npm install? Bun 1.3 Does It in 8 Seconds
item.description: Bun 1.3 packs a runtime, package manager, bundler, and test framework into a single executable. A large Remix project that takes npm 3 minutes 20 seconds to install? Bun does it in 8 seconds. Built-in SQL client, Redis client, zero-config frontend dev -- here's what actually changed.

item.title: Frontend Performance Optimization: I Replaced Axios With 25 Lines of Vanilla JS
item.description: Discovered that 13KB Axios is just a fetch wrapper. Using 25 lines of vanilla JS to achieve the same functionality while reducing bundle size by 92%. A real frontend performance optimization case.

item.title: WebGPU Performance Test: 23x Faster than WebAssembly - The Browser Computing Revolution
item.description: Real-world test shows WebGPU is 23x faster than WebAssembly. This article explains GPU parallel computing principles and implementation details through three actual case studies of data visualization, image processing, and physics simulation.

item.title: Snapdom: A New Engine for Web Screenshots, Say Goodbye to Lag
item.description: Snapdom gained 2000+ stars in two months - how does it use SVG magic to make web screenshots lightning fast? Say goodbye to html2canvas lag and experience the modern web screenshot solution

item.title: Stop Using substr(): The Deprecated JavaScript API and the Right Replacements (slice vs substring)
item.description: substr() is deprecated and risky to rely on. This guide explains why, contrasts it with slice() and substring(), and provides a clear migration checklist and best practices.

item.title: LocalStorage 5 Critical Secrets: Essential Guide Every Developer Must Know
item.description: Deep dive into LocalStorage's 5 critical flaws: synchronous blocking, cross-window communication, data type limitations, storage capacity limits, and security vulnerabilities. Includes practical code examples and best practices.
